int findBinaryExponentian(int a, int pow, int mod) {
    if (pow == 1) {
        return a;
    } else if (pow == 0) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        int retVal = findBinaryExponentian(a, pow / 2, mod);
        int val = (pow % 2 == 0) ? 1 : a;
        return ((long long) retVal * retVal % mod * val) % mod;
    }
}

int findPow(int a, int b, int mod) {
    if (b == 1) {
        return a % mod;
    } else if (b == 0) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        int res = findPow(a, b / 2, mod);
        return ((long long) res * res % mod * ((b % 2 == 1) ? a : 1)) % mod;
    }
}

int bleft(int ele, int sortedArr[], int size) {
    int l = 0;
    int h = size - 1;
    int ans = -1;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (sortedArr[mid] < ele) {
            ans = mid;
            l = mid + 1;
        } else {
            h = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int div = b;
    int rem = a % b;
    while (rem != 0) {
        int temp = rem;
        rem = div % rem;
        div = temp;
    }
    return div;
}
